description: Angular component for configuring geofencing settings within the Thingsboard platform, including form controls, validation, and change detection.

classes.name: GeofencingConfigurationComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for geofencing configuration form.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updates current entity filter.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the form, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Updates form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch events (not used).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: updatedModel
methods.description: Sets the type of configuration and propagates change.

methods.name: checkScheduledUpdateEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the scheduled update interval control based on the toggle.

methods.name: checkRelatedEntity
methods.description: Determines if the zone groups reference related entities.
